phases.title: Forever leveling 1–10: DoTs och wand
phases.desc: Corruption unlocks at 4, Life Tap at 6, and Bane of Agony at 8. A Bane is separate from a Curse. Stop and stand still for half a second before shooting your wand.

phases.title: Forever leveling 10–19: Voidwalker
phases.desc: Unlock Voidwalker at 10 and let it build threat before applying DoTs. Improved Corruption 5/5 makes Corruption instant at 14. Drain Life is also learned at 14.

phases.title: Forever leveling 20–29: Pandemic
phases.desc: Pandemic becomes available through talent points starting at 20. Bane of Agony can coexist with a Curse; Curse of the Elements is learned at 20 and helps in longer fights.

phases.title: Forever leveling 30–39: Affliction och demon-utility
phases.desc: Siphon Life becomes available at 30 talent points/level 30. The Felhunter unlocks at 30 with Devour Magic; Spell Lock follows at 36. Spellstone is a weapon imbue from 36.

phases.title: Forever leveling 40–49: Wrack och Felsteed
phases.desc: Wrack unlocks with 31 Affliction points at level 40. It is a 6-second channel, not an instant filler. Felsteed is the level-40 mount; Death Coil is learned at 42.

phases.title: Forever leveling 50–60: senare milstolpar
phases.desc: Inferno unlocks at 50. Bane of Doom, Portal of Summoning, and Dreadsteed are learned at 60. Verify higher-level builds in-game; some published theory is still untested.

spells.name: Immolate / Shadow Bolt / Demon Skin
spells.desc: Starting spells. Immolate is available at level 1 in Forever.

spells.name: Corruption / Curse of Weakness
spells.desc: Corruption is a DoT; Weakness is a Curse.

spells.name: Life Tap
spells.desc: Grants mana based on its base value plus Spirit; Spirit scaling applies from the first rank.

spells.name: Bane of Agony / Fear
spells.desc: Agony is a Bane, not a Curse, so it can be combined with a Curse.

spells.name: Voidwalker Quest / Drain Soul / Healthstone
spells.desc: Drain Soul always grants a shard if the target dies during the channel; the chance from damage ticks was reduced in recent notes.

spells.name: Health Funnel
spells.desc: Heals your demon.

spells.name: Drain Life / Curse of Recklessness
spells.desc: Drain Life is a 5-second channel. Recklessness prevents the target from fleeing and counters Fear.

spells.name: Unending Breath
spells.desc: Forever rank milestone.

spells.name: Soulstone / Searing Pain / Gravestone Scepter
spells.desc: Gravestone Scepter from Blackfathom Villainy is a useful wand from around level 18.

spells.name: Curse of the Elements / Demon Armor / Succubus / Incubus
spells.desc: Curse of the Elements affects every magic school. Sayaad pet options unlock at 20.

spells.name: Ritual of Summoning
spells.desc: Requires the caster and two group members; Meeting Stones do not summon in Forever.

spells.name: Drain Life Rank 2 / Healthstone Rank 2
spells.desc: Forever rank milestone.

spells.name: Drain Mana / Sense Demons
spells.desc: Forever rank milestone.

spells.name: Curse of Tongues
spells.desc: This is a Curse, not a Bane.

spells.name: Banish / Firestone
spells.desc: Firestone is a weapon imbue, not an off-hand item.

spells.name: Siphon Life / Felhunter / Hellfire
spells.desc: Siphon Life requires 21 Affliction points. Felhunter learns Devour Magic at 30.

spells.name: Shadow Ward / Fear Rank 2
spells.desc: Forever rank milestone.

spells.name: Spellstone / Felhunter Spell Lock
spells.desc: Spellstone is a weapon imbue; the Felhunter interrupt unlocks at 36, not 30.

spells.name: Wrack / Howl of Terror / Felsteed
spells.desc: Wrack is a 6-second channel requiring 31 Affliction points. Felsteed is the level-40 mount.

spells.name: Death Coil
spells.desc: A 3-second horror that also heals you for the damage dealt.

spells.name: Soul Fire
spells.desc: Costs one Soul Shard and has a long cast time.

spells.name: Inferno
spells.desc: Requires an Infernal Stone according to client data.

spells.name: Bane of Doom / Portal of Summoning / Dreadsteed
spells.desc: Forever milestones; Bane of Doom shares the Bane slot with Agony.

wands.name: Fang of Magmatus / Dwarven Tome
wands.source: Forever dungeon/quest leads; verify faction and availability

wands.name: Gnarled Necromancer's Staff / Coldspire Staff
wands.source: Ruins of Lordaeron; check drops/quests in Forever

quests.title: Voidwalker class quest
quests.desc: The Horde chain ends with Carendin Halgar in Undercity; follow your quest log starting at level 10.

quests.title: Succubus / Incubus
quests.desc: The Classic Succubus chain remains; Forever also adds Incubus quests. The exact chain depends on your faction.

quests.title: Orb of Soran'ruk
quests.desc: Forever quest chain with a weapon choice; the XP reward changed from Classic.

quests.title: Felhunter class quest
quests.desc: The Classic chain appears in quest data, but verify in-game whether it is still required.

quests.title: Felsteed
quests.desc: Level-40 mount. Follow the current trainer/quest in-game; costs and quest details may differ.

quests.title: Dreadsteed of Xoroth
quests.desc: Level-60 quest chain. Do not confuse it with a Soul Harvester weapon quest.

zone_routes.title: Deathknell & Tirisfal Glades
zone_routes.desc: Complete the starting chain and pick up the Imp quest. The Voidwalker quest becomes available at 10.

zone_routes.title: Silverpine Forest / The Barrens
zone_routes.desc: Get your Voidwalker. The Barrens is a Horde zone for levels 10–25; a wand and DoTs reduce downtime.

zone_routes.title: Hillsbrad Foothills / Ashenvale
zone_routes.desc: Pandemic and new Forever dungeon/quest options change the Classic route. Follow level ranges and your quest log.

zone_routes.title: Arathi / Stranglethorn Vale
zone_routes.desc: Siphon Life is a 21-point milestone. The Felhunter adds utility; Spell Lock unlocks at 36.

zone_routes.title: Riverglades (contested) / Dustwallow / Badlands
zone_routes.desc: Riverglades is a new contested zone with a client level range of 36–44. Quests and enemy levels may differ; verify in-game.

zone_routes.title: Tanaris / Hinterlands / Feralas
zone_routes.desc: Felsteed at 40; Wrack is a channel. Choose a zone based on quests and actual XP.

zone_routes.title: Felwood / Plaguelands / Winterspring / Silithus
zone_routes.desc: Inferno at 50; Bane of Doom and Portal of Summoning at 60. No Soul Harvester scythe quest is confirmed.

macros.title: Pet Attack + Corruption
macros.desc: Sends your pet to attack and casts Corruption.

macros.title: Mouseover Bane of Agony
macros.desc: Casts Agony on your mouseover target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Bane of Agony
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Bane of Agony

macros.title: Mouseover Curse of Weakness
macros.desc: Casts Curse of Weakness on a hostile mouseover target, or your current target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Curse of Weakness
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Curse of Weakness

macros.title: Drain Soul: shard finisher
macros.desc: Use the current rank and let the channel finish. Killing an eligible target during the channel always grants a shard; damage ticks grant shards less often after the latest change.

macros.title: Health Funnel: Pet
macros.desc: Heals your active demon with Health Funnel.

macros.title: Use Healthstone
macros.desc: Uses a Healthstone when one is in your bags.

macros.title: Pet Follow
macros.desc: Calls your demon back and stops it from attacking.

affliction.name: Improved Corruption
affliction.desc: Reduces Corruption's cast time; 5/5 makes it instant.

affliction.name: Suppression
affliction.desc: Grants up to 5% Hit to Affliction spells and reduces threat.

affliction.name: Improved Life Tap
affliction.desc: Forever talent. Check the current tooltip for its exact value.

affliction.name: Grim Reach
affliction.desc: Increases the range of Affliction spells.

affliction.name: Soul Harvest
affliction.desc: Improves mana recovery while Drain Soul is active on a dying target.

affliction.name: Pandemic
affliction.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus for DoTs and drains; DoTs can critically strike in Forever.

affliction.name: Improved Drains
affliction.desc: Improves drain spells. The Nov 3 Drain Mana change means this talent no longer increases Wrack damage.

affliction.name: Improved Bane of Agony
affliction.desc: Forever talent that improves Bane of Agony.

affliction.name: Amplify Curse
affliction.desc: Empowers your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony; required for Curse of Exhaustion.

affliction.name: Nightfall
affliction.desc: Corruption and drains can proc an instant Shadow Bolt.

affliction.name: Curse of Exhaustion
affliction.desc: Affliction capstone talent; requires Amplify Curse.

affliction.name: Siphon Life
affliction.desc: 21-point milestone; a DoT that heals you.

affliction.name: Soul Siphon
affliction.desc: Increases Drain Life/Drain Soul value for each Affliction effect on the target.

affliction.name: Fel Concentration
affliction.desc: Forever has 3 ranks, not 5; reduces cast interruption while draining.

affliction.name: Shadow Mastery
affliction.desc: Increases Shadow damage by 2% per point, up to 10%.

affliction.name: Wrack
affliction.desc: 31-point milestone. A 6-second channel that speeds up your other Shadow DoTs on the target while active.

demonology.name: Demonic Energies
demonology.desc: Helps keep your demon alive through the Warlock's spell damage.
